Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE new Nightglass comic panel, square composition, no text, no lettering, no balloons. Reference 1 supplies original thin controlled anime drawing, elegant face proportions, inhabited navy/cyan city with selective amber windows. Reference 2 supplies stable cast construction ONLY: Aren is slim adult dark-haired man in long-sleeved ivory waist jacket, black high-neck shirt/trousers/gloves, red courier cord; Pell older gray-haired stubbled man in mustard work jacket. Exclude the sheet's tall rig, spear, ray and extra people. Reference 3 is CURRENT STATE/geography control only, not visual style. Reference 4 if supplied is the preceding selected panel: preserve its identities and current physical geography, but advance exactly the new action/state below. Use expressive attractive acting, clear hands, broad quiet surface shapes, matte stone, no microtexture everywhere. Scene: old postal stair, blue night, warm windows distant. Aren applies Hold and slows at the lower landing. Boots touch stone; his LEFT elbow catches the projecting iron tooth beside the post, making one clear tear in the ivory LEFT sleeve. His right sword points down-left; cyan line remains ring-to-post, taut during his last braking instant; boots are just making contact.
Current state authoritative: New torn LEFT elbow sleeve; previous torn hem persists. Envelope still hidden chest. One ring-to-post line, no blade contact with rail.
Camera: medium side, feet and snag readable. Keep quiet dark upper 20 percent for later dialogue. One black envelope only, in the stated location; cream wallet concealed; do not add objects from sheet. No future damage or characters. One frozen moment. Make visible causal hand/contact/endpoint information clear.

inspection: RIGHT weapon and single rear-pommel line retained; LEFT sleeve torn but elbow snag not shown: LEFT hand grips post below projecting tooth. Hem intact. Boots braking/landing readable. One targeted repair authorized for missing causal snag.
